prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity professional personal portfolio homepage for Shubham Wankar, aimed at recruiters and hiring managers evaluating senior data science candidates. This is a NEW visual proposal for review, not the previously shown oversized vintage folio. Render ONE continuous MOBILE website page edge-to-edge, approximately a 390 CSS pixel width by 1050 CSS pixel tall scroll excerpt. No phone device, browser chrome, perspective, floating desktop mockups, or concept-board surround. Scale type like a real phone: body 16px, primary headline approximately 34–40px, section headings 24px. Everything has ample breathing room and usable controls. Restrained professional design, exceptional typography, coherent alignment, explicit visual hierarchy.
Use this truthful content, keeping text concise and accurate:
Name: "Shubham Wankar".
Expertise: "Data science & applied AI".
Introduction: "Building AI that works in production."
Supporting sentence: "Architecture, model evaluation, deployment, and stakeholder coordination."
Primary actions: "View resume" and "Get in touch"; visible early.
Featured work title: "Executive evaluation".
Description: "An AI microservice generating performance ratings and summaries from feedback and KPIs."
Processing comparison labels: "Previous service" with "~8 min", "New service" with "<1 min". These are processing times, not all executive evaluations combined. Show "~8 min → <1 min" with the tilde and less-than symbol intact. One comparison visual is enough; no duplicate metrics.
Scope: "20 executives supported".
Qualitative result: "More consistent evaluation across feedback and KPIs."
A "View case study" link.
Following section: "Selected projects", including actual project titles "Text-to-SQL LLM app" with "Python · LangChain · Gemini API" and "Next word prediction" with "Python · HuggingFace · FastAPI".
Small navigation links may include Work, About, Contact; mobile menu button is fine. Do not fabricate job titles, project screenshots, employer attribution, logos, metrics, testimonials, faces or experience counts. No parchment, aged paper, ornate rules, retro pixel type, science fiction rings, gradients, giant number dashboard, generic icon-card grids, or unsupported architecture diagrams. Name and expertise must be clear immediately; the featured work supports the person's portfolio.

VISUAL DIRECTION: contemporary professional Swiss graphic design for an accomplished applied AI specialist. Pure white, deep navy typography, muted steel-blue secondary text, a restrained deep teal action color. Use a contemporary humanist sans throughout, medium-weight display with excellent proportions. STRUCTURE: narrow top navigation with Shubham Wankar and menu; generous but compact personal introduction and horizontally paired resume/contact actions; a thin rule; featured case study presented as one elegant pale blue-gray unboxed band occupying full content width, with a compact two-row before/after timing comparison and clear labels, plain scope text and ownership copy. Two carefully arranged, text-only project rows follow with thin separators and small arrows. Precise minimalist composition, confident whitespace, refined enterprise credibility. No large serif type. The result should feel custom, polished and credible for senior data science hiring.
